name: Microgrid island voltage-reference block
aliases: microgrids Microgrid voltage and reactive-power controls
summary: Provides the assigned voltage target to the resource establishing the island AC reference.
description: Provides the assigned voltage target to the resource establishing the island AC reference. Voltage and reactive-power control coordinate the AC operating condition of the microgrid resources. A voltage target, reactive-power target and power-factor target represent different control objectives and should have explicit ownership.

In an islanded microgrid, the assigned reference source supports bus voltage while other compatible resources share reactive demand according to the selected control method. Grid-connected operation can use a different objective at the PCC. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Authorized island voltage target” at the input and “Grid-forming voltage reference” at the output. The selected resource must support the operating role.
